question: Based on the alphabetical order, three of the following four are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the one that does NOT belong to that group?
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb94de4777f6f57a9f5e4c238b0187c9c2ade11c8c20148320b4d392458d7a7c.png] ​
